claim: The Service Quotas default for Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances is 5, and the quota is adjustable.
question: What is the Service Quotas default value for running On-Demand Standard instances, and is it adjustable?

values.display: Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances | 5
values.spoken: a default of five for Standard instances

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region; measured in vCPUs
qualifiers.condition: Standard families A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z; EC2 raises the quota automatically with usage and new accounts may start lower

note: The FAQ lists 1152 vCPUs for the same family limit (see ec2-faq-standard-vcpu-limit-1152).
